semantic.justification: Original consumed ZipFile END/CEN/LOC/ZIP64/data-descriptor/extra-field validation over actual ByteGrabber/native UNO streams, original RTL hashes/OUString copies and native RefCountedMutex guards; occupied intervals, duplicate/case checks and source exception boundaries retained. EntryHash lowers the source native map with RTL hash/equality and independent key/value copies; ZipEnumeration returns actual mapped records. Recovery=false is the intentional approved browser profile. Original crypto, entry streams/inflation, ZIP writing, ZipPackage/OStorage factories, model/UI acceptance and physical C++ iterator/allocation ABI remain unfinished or unqualified. EntryHash lookup now accepts the original const OUString reference contract, without changing hashing or entry identity.
